constraints: Browse the live web and GitHub thoroughly; do not rely on memory alone.
Top set must work without X account, login, cookies or paid API keys; tools needing auth go to backups only with explicit label.
Distinguish verified no-login mechanism from untested README claims; mark anything unverifiable PARTIAL/BLOCKED.
Prefer maintained repos with activity in 2024-2026; flag archived or dead projects explicitly.

deliverables.description: Ranked findings with evidence, no-login mechanism, maintenance signal and open gaps.
Machine-readable ranked list of repos with URLs, mechanism and maintenance signal.

facts: User states good GitHub repos exist that scrape X posts without any account or login.
hypotheses: Candidates may use Nitter mirrors, guest-token flows, syndication/embed endpoints, or unofficial public APIs.
Some popular scrapers may now be broken by X front-end changes; maintenance date matters.
purpose: Find the best GitHub repos to scrape posts from X without any account or login.

acceptance.condition: At least 20 candidates surveyed across keyword families; search method and queries listed so work is reproducible.

requirements.requirement: Survey GitHub extremely thoroughly for X/Twitter post scrapers.

acceptance.condition: Top 12-15 ranked repos each show URL, stars, last-update signal, exact no-login mechanism, what post fields it yields, and why it ranks where it does; 5-8 auth-needing or dead backups listed separately.

requirements.requirement: Rank the best no-login set with verifiable evidence.

acceptance.condition: Top 3 picks each have install command, minimal scrape-posts example, and stated limits/risks (rate limits, breakage, legal/ToS note).

requirements.requirement: Give runnable starter guidance and limits for the top picks.

assumptions: Public GitHub and web browsing are available to the responder.
No local source files are needed; evidence comes from live GitHub inspection.

in: Search GitHub code/repo search across twitter-scraper, x-scraper, tweets-scraper, nitter, guest-token, syndication families.
Inspect README, release/commit recency, stars, issues, and no-login mechanism for each candidate.
Rank a no-login best set plus labelled backups needing auth or dead.
out: Recommend paid X API or any tool requiring login/cookies/API keys as a top pick.
Run scrapers or claim live-test PASS without execution.

stop_condition: Deliver x-scrape-report.md and x-scrape-repos.json; mark unverified no-login claims PARTIAL/BLOCKED with explicit limitations.
title: GitHub survey - no-login X post scrapers
task: Explore GitHub extremely thoroughly and return the best set of repos that scrape X posts without any account or login, with evidence and starter usage.
